name: Lunar Domain
description:
When the opponent is affected by Lunar-Charged: Also apply Electric Shock to 3 random cards in the opponent's Hand, increase DMG dealt by your Lunar-Charged by 2, and set the DMG dealt by your Thundercloud to 3.
When the opponent is affected by Lunar-Bloom: Apply Cost Reduction to a random card in your Hand 3 times instead.
When the opponent is affected by Lunar-Crystallize: The number of Moondrift Harmony generated is changed to 3.
Usage(s): 3
